people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jericho
people.line: An ancient city in Canaan, famously conquered by Israel

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Rahab
people.line: A Canaanite woman who helped the Israelite spies in Jericho

translations.web: But Rahab the prostitute, her father’s household, and all that she had, Joshua saved alive. She lives in the middle of Israel to this day, because she hid the messengers whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
translations.bsb: And Joshua spared Rahab the prostitute, with her father’s household and all who belonged to her, because she hid the men Joshua had sent to spy out Jericho. So she has lived among the Israelites to this day.
translations.kjv: And Joshua saved Rahab the harlot alive, and her father's household, and all that she had; and she dwelleth in Israel even unto this day; because she hid the messengers, which Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
translations.asv: But Rahab the harlot, and her father's household, and all that she had, did Joshua save alive; and she dwelt in the midst of Israel unto this day, because she hid the messengers, whom Joshua sent to spy out Jericho.
